runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on official monitoring pages and current Planning Data metadata, with strict separation of historic HDT results, current dataset recency, permission status and actual completion.

sources.label: LBBD Monitoring and evidence base library
sources.fact: Council lists Authority Monitoring Report 2023-24 and explains AMRs report policy implementation for the previous financial year and planning-document progress.

sources.label: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: Current statutory plan context is London Plan 2021 plus LBBD Local Plan 2037 and Joint Waste Development Plan; LBBD Local Plan adopted 18 September 2024.

sources.label: LBBD Supplementary Planning Documents
sources.fact: Thames Road SPD adopted 14 May 2025 and Planning Obligations SPD adopted 18 September 2024; adopted and draft SPDs are explicitly distinct.

sources.label: Planning Data Brownfield land
sources.fact: 37,666 records from 354 providers; collector 23 July 2026; new data 22 July 2026; origin all authoritative sources.

sources.label: Planning Data Brownfield site
sources.fact: Experimental boundary dataset with 2,916 sites from 5 providers; MHCLG-created and expected to be replaced by authoritative data.

sources.label: Planning Data Planning application
sources.fact: 100,627 records from 6 providers; collector/new data 17 September 2025; MHCLG-created and not current comprehensive national application truth.

sources.label: Planning Data Planning permission status
sources.fact: Authoritative controlled vocabulary distinguishes permissioned, not-permissioned and pending-decision.

sources.label: Planning Data Planning permission type
sources.fact: Authoritative controlled vocabulary distinguishes full, outline, reserved matters, permission in principle, technical details consent and other permission types.

sources.label: Planning Data Planning application condition
sources.fact: 5,305 condition records; one provider; latest collected 26 July 2026 but source origin is MHCLG-created and not comprehensive national condition coverage.

sources.label: Planning Data Ownership status
sources.fact: Authoritative controlled vocabulary includes public, non-public, mixed and unknown ownership; ownership status does not prove development control or deliverability.

sources.label: LBBD Housing Delivery Test Action Plan 2020
sources.fact: Historical action plan records the 2020 HDT measurement at 57%; it is retained only as historic evidence and must not be treated as the current 2026 delivery rate.

sources.label: Planning Data datasets index
sources.fact: Dataset catalogue separates geography, legal instrument, document, organisation, policy, metric and timetable data; coverage varies by dataset and provider.

examples.result: AMR 2023-24 is the latest AMR visibly listed on the council monitoring page; reporting period retained rather than silently labelled 2026.
Brownfield land dataset freshness revalidated at collector 23 July 2026/new data 22 July 2026; membership remains development-potential evidence, not completion.
Brownfield-site boundaries remain experimental; no exact parcel relation promoted from that layer alone.
Planning application dataset recency is only September 2025 and coverage is six providers; absence is not negative planning proof.
Permissioned/not-permissioned/pending-decision statuses are kept distinct and never converted directly to delivery probability.
Permission type distinctions retained: outline, full and reserved matters are not interchangeable completion states.
Historic HDT 2020 result tagged HISTORIC_ONLY; no use as current 2026 borough delivery score.
Planning-condition dataset is not comprehensive national coverage; missing condition records cannot be interpreted as no conditions.
